THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
EDITOR'S LETTER
002
THE IMAGE IS
THE BEGINNING.
A working magazine for looking closely - and making
something new.
Nine chapters bring this collection of 174 studies into focus. Each
page places the complete original prompt beside its linked
reference, with the original working notes below. The glossary
introduces recurring photographic and clothing terms.
The prompts were written for DALL-E-style image tools. “Image
Prompt” is used throughout as a neutral label. To explore a study,
paste its prompt into your preferred image tool and use the
reference attachment when supported. The added “Try this” line
draws only from that study's existing notes.
Study numbers, titles, prompts and working notes are preserved. Six reference links and Source filenames were corrected
with publisher approval. Repeats Study identifies shared or closely related references. Rights check asks the publisher to
verify likeness and publication permissions; it does not establish anyone's identity.
